object: On-call staff must confirm receipt of the alert within 15 minutes.
subject: Initial Notification

object: Clinicians should route unresolved alerts to the secondary on-call physician.
subject: Secondary Contact

object: The vendor liaison must record every escalation in the incident log.
subject: Vendor Escalation

object: Staff should confirm legal has been notified for any reportable event.
subject: Legal Notification

object: Care coordinators must confirm the patient has been informed of the outcome.
subject: Patient Communication

object: The safety committee should record findings within five business days.
subject: Post-Incident Review
